build_touch_detection_model: build a ResNet18-based touch detection model with frozen base layers and a custom classification head
run_touch_detection_forward: run inference on a frame tensor through the touch detection model to get class predictions
test_training_step: test the training step that computes cross-entropy loss on image-target batches and logs train_loss
test_validation_step: test the validation step that computes loss and accuracy metrics on image-target batches
review_configure_optimizers: review the optimizer configuration that sets up MADGRAD with the specified learning rate
